summary: Materialize bounded immutable local Git branch topology without repository mutation

delivery.outcome: Provide exact, deterministic and read-only Git topology evidence for later t2c.branch/v1 semantic assembly
nonGoals: No semantic comparison or completeness claim
No pipeline artifact or per-tree todo2code analysis
No CLI, MCP, A2A, SDK or published schema
No GitHub API, PR metadata, remote fetch or LLM
No ref, index, worktree or repository object mutation
No Goal, Koru or Validator adapter

architecture.decision: Separate immutable local Git observation from semantic evidence assembly and expose no public interface in this ticket
dataChanges: Add an in-memory internal Git materialization; no persisted or public schema
architecture.rollback: Remove the two additive runtime files; ticket-037 core behavior and every existing interface remain unchanged
